summary.text: A human calamity is a tribulation form in which people and their forces become the trial. It sits beside earthly calamities and heavenly tribulations, not among named immortal materials.

claims.text: Fang Yuan suspects Chu Du was influenced by heaven’s will and made part of a human calamity plot against him during the first earthly calamity collaboration.

After a mild profound white flying salt earthly calamity ends and Fang Yuan retrieves his immortal aperture, surroundings shift into a battlefield killer move with nine Gu Immortals and an immemorial desolate beast. He names it a human calamity: heaven’s will had stretched the tribulation to set that deadly situation.

Fang Yuan concludes that earthly calamities no longer stop him for now, and that the problem is human calamities. He links heaven’s will conjuring human calamities to earthly calamities failing to kill him, and treats the fourth earthly calamity’s human calamity, which even brought an immemorial rock dragon, as far beyond his limits. In the fifth earthly calamity he meets no human calamity, reading that as heaven’s will lacking time to construct one because he is a complete otherworldly demon and moved too quickly.

Inside Calamity Luck Altar, Heaven Extremity calls Five Elements Grandmaster’s invasion a human calamity against Longevity Heaven, and says the altar can turn that difficulty into good luck for the grotto-heaven. Five Elements Grandmaster asks how human calamity compares with earthly calamities and heavenly tribulations; Heaven Extremity says they reverse those as well into nourishment. Heaven Extremity adds that if heaven cannot destroy Longevity Heaven with calamities and tribulations, it will use human calamities, and that Five Elements Grandmaster was subconsciously influenced by heaven’s will into becoming that human calamity.
Periodic blessed-land trials in general are covered on Calamities and Tribulations. Earthly Calamity covers the ordinary ten-year land trial, which is a different subject from this page.
